our_interpretation: The subject is OpenAI's and Anthropic's contractual compute payments, taken together.
The plain reading is a substantial increase in annual payments in 2027 relative to 2026, followed by substantial increases each subsequent year.
No numerical definition of 'in earnest' or 'dramatically' is supplied. I do not invent one.
The horizon below covers the expressly dated 2027 ramp. The subsequent annual-growth assertion has no final deadline.
The parenthetical expresses doubt about the industry's survival; it is not a clear conditional antecedent.
criteria.support_condition: Comparable payment records show a substantial ramp in 2027 relative to 2026 and substantial annual increases thereafter. A finite record can support only the years observed, not an indefinite continuation.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Comparable records show no substantial 2027 ramp, or a subsequent completed year clearly fails to show the asserted substantial increase.
